prompt: Round 3 of 4. The researcher side proposes (We want university ownership of results with a non-exclusive licence to the company, as this is our standard positio

content.text:
The researcher wants uni_owns_nonexclusive_licence and 30-day review. I want company_owns. I can trade on IP - accept uni_owns_option_to_assign (compromise) and push review back to 60 days. Or I could accept uni_owns_nonexclusive_licence but push for 60-day review. 

I can only change at most two fields. Let me change ip to company_owns_uni_academic_use (better for us than non-exclusive licence) and reviewDays to 60.
